findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "fix-and-flip" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fix_and_flip_term_sheet_requirements · Private data: request_fix_and_flip_term_sheet · Public sink: fix_and_flip_term_sheet_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fix_and_flip_term_sheet_requirements · Private data: request_fix_and_flip_term_sheet · Public sink: fix_and_flip_term_sheet_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
